about: The verdict dashlint should give every tile and alert of the demo PostHog project, worked out by hand from the verdict rules and the seeded patterns before dashlint was ever run on the demo. A run that disagrees is a bug in dashlint or a documented decision, never an edit to this file.

notes: One platform means exactly one platform id: a tile fed only by the mobile app (ios and android) is live, a tile fed only by the web app is one platform.
All-events nodes and events with no known platform never make a tile one platform.
Pattern 4 follows PostHog's case-sensitive exact match, so "Card" never matches "card".

tiles.title: Gift card redemptions
tiles.reason: gift_card_redeemed has no call site (the code sends giftcard_redeemed) and never arrives.

tiles.title: Book views by genre
tiles.reason: exact filter on genre, a property book_viewed never carries (the code sends genre_id); a positive filter on a never-sent property matches nothing.

tiles.title: Review submissions
tiles.reason: review_submitted is sent only by the web app.

tiles.title: Added to cart (any platform)
tiles.reason: action over added_to_cart (web) and added_to_cart_native (ios, android); both are sent.

tiles.title: Wishlist adds (current and legacy)
info: wishlist_added_legacy is a dead member of a live OR group
tiles.reason: OR group: wishlist_added (web) and wishlist_synced (ios, android) are live, so the group is live.

tiles.title: Book returns
tiles.reason: book_returned has a web call site, so it is live and web only; it never arrives, which the notArriving section reports.

tiles.title: Daily active users
tiles.reason: all-events node with DAU math: live, and never one platform.

tiles.title: Books viewed
tiles.reason: book_viewed is sent only by the web app (mobile sends book_viewed_native).

tiles.title: Searches performed
tiles.reason: search_performed is sent only by the web app.

tiles.title: Added to cart (web)
tiles.reason: added_to_cart is sent only by the web app.

tiles.title: Checkouts started
tiles.reason: checkout_started is sent only by the web app.

tiles.title: Orders completed (web)
tiles.reason: order_completed is sent only by the web app.

tiles.title: Revenue (web)
tiles.reason: sum of total on order_completed: total is always sent; web only.

tiles.title: Newsletter signups
tiles.reason: newsletter_signup is sent only by the web app.

tiles.title: Shares via email
tiles.reason: no literal call site sends shared_via_email, but the open-world capture (shared_via_ plus a string) could, so the code fact is unknown; the event arrives, so it is live. Its platforms are unknown, so it is not one platform.

tiles.title: Browse to cart
tiles.reason: both steps (book_viewed, added_to_cart) are sent, web only.

tiles.title: Cart to order
tiles.reason: both steps (added_to_cart, order_completed) are sent, web only.

tiles.title: Weekly active users
tiles.reason: all-events node with weekly-active math.

tiles.title: Orders by format
tiles.reason: breakdown on format, never sent on order_completed: every row lands in one (none) bucket.

tiles.title: Checkout funnel (by payment method)
tiles.reason: step 2 filters payment_method = "Card"; the code only sends "card" or "cash" and exact is case-sensitive, so step 2 is dead and steps 2 to 3 are always zero.

tiles.title: Discount conversion
tiles.reason: formula B/A where B is discount_applied, which has no call site and never arrives: the formula is always zero.

tiles.title: Checkout funnel health
tiles.reason: the part is the formula B/A over checkout_started and order_completed, both sent, web only. Its alert is the invalid-target case.

tiles.title: Checkouts started (all platforms)
tiles.reason: despite the title, checkout_started is sent only by the web app.

tiles.title: Orders completed (mobile)
tiles.reason: order_completed_native is sent by the mobile app (ios and android).

tiles.title: Checkout funnel (web)
tiles.reason: both steps (checkout_started, order_completed) are sent, web only.

tiles.title: Average order value (mobile)
tiles.reason: average of total on order_completed_native: total is always sent; ios and android.

tiles.title: Orders excluding gift wrap
tiles.reason: is_not filter on gift_wrap, never sent on order_completed_native: a negative filter on a missing property keeps every event, so the filter has no effect.

tiles.title: Revenue per device
tiles.reason: a SQL insight; dashlint does not read SQL.

tiles.title: App opened funnel
tiles.reason: Application Opened and Application Became Active are posthog-react-native builtins, on because the init sets captureAppLifecycleEvents: true; both arrive.

tiles.title: Wishlist synced (mobile)
tiles.reason: wishlist_synced is sent by the mobile app (ios and android).

tiles.title: Added to cart (mobile)
tiles.reason: added_to_cart_native is sent by the mobile app (ios and android).

tiles.title: Payment method selected
tiles.reason: payment_method_selected is sent by the mobile app (ios and android).

alerts.name: Checkout funnel health
alerts.reason: series_index 2, but the insight has one formula and with formulas the index counts formula results.

alerts.name: Gift card redemptions dropped
alerts.reason: relative decrease on a dead series: a constant zero never decreases.

alerts.name: Gift card redemptions below one
alerts.reason: absolute value with lower bound 1 on a dead series: zero is always below it.

alerts.name: Web orders below one
alerts.reason: absolute value with lower bound 1 on a live series: a healthy alert, no finding.

alerts.name: v4 spike: never-sent relative decrease
alerts.reason: v4_never_sent has no call site and never arrives; relative decrease on a constant zero.

alerts.name: v4 spike: never-sent absolute lower
alerts.reason: absolute value with lower bound 1 on a dead series.

alerts.name: v4 spike: never-sent absolute upper
alerts.reason: absolute value with only an upper bound (100) on a dead series.

alerts.name: v4 spike: daily relative decrease
alerts.reason: v4_daily has no call site but arrives once a day from the traffic script (produced elsewhere), so the series is live.
